headline: St. Thomas Aquinas pull clear as the last unbeaten side
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas have met every other member and lost to none of them, and have since won at Pace and at Adelphi. Mercy, the side they beat to open conference play, have beaten Queens again and are the next to try.
displaced_by: District of Columbia's draw with Molloy means the standing dek's line that they had not dropped a point is no longer true; the headline still holds

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not ordered the table: Mercy and Queens have each outscored every other programme on the chart, and that includes the leaders, St. Thomas Aquinas.

wire.line: No conference member has beaten St. Thomas Aquinas; Mercy, who opened conference play against them, get another try.

findings.label: observed

findings.text: Molloy have drawn eight matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored thirteen of Mercy's 37 goals from 52 shots.

last_match.line: Mercy have beaten Queens twice this month, both times without conceding.

next_match.line: St. Thomas Aquinas have won every match since their defeat at Millersville; Mercy have not lost since Molloy beat them.
